Name: Shoom's Mister Ginger Portraits
Author: shoom611
Description:
Alternate portraits for lemurkat's custom NPC, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5295]Mister Ginger[/url] (Which I absolutely adore). Originally made for my own playthrough I decided to upload it here.

[i]Additional thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/lemurkat?gameId=1303]lemurkat[/url] for permission to upload this mod![/i]
[b]
How to install:[/b]
1. Extract the RAR file using WinRAR or 7Zip
2. Move the folder "[CP] shoom's Mister Ginger Portraits" into your dedicated Stardew Valley mod folder
3. Run SMAPI and go talk to Mister Ginger to see the portraits working in action :)
